goal: Within one imm-run entry the run recovers by itself and is not paused by waiting: both continuation hooks allow two native-operation failures before pausing; a Claude Stop that repeats with no progress after one continuation nudge is allowed without counting toward a pause; the agent applies and commits alone a deterministic preflight fix before retrying; a Pi user interrupt revokes the entry token and the Claude MCP server itself refuses token-backed operations while the run is paused; and the packaged Loop contract states the retry rules, the single native gate kept on enroll and batch start, and the remaining user stops (Spec D9, D10, D12, D13).

acceptance.assertion: On each Host the first and second native-operation failure under one entry token leave the run live and native tools admitted; the third pauses the run and denies native tools; a new literal entry resets the count.

The packaged imm-run contracts and BASELINE state that a literal entry needs no chat confirmation while enroll and unattended batch start each keep one native gate, that only side-effect-free rejections are retried at most twice after rerunning preflight, that plan_changed, head_moved and claim conflicts are never retried, that a deterministic preflight fix is committed alone and listed in the manifest, and that push, PR, credentials, breaking intent revision and rework exits still stop for the user.

On Claude, after one Stop block with no progress, further Stops with stop_hook_active true and an unchanged progress digest are allowed (no block), never pause the run and never revoke the token, however many occur; native tools stay admitted; once progress changes, the next incomplete Stop blocks again.

A Pi turn that settles with a non-completed outcome or canContinue false under a live token revokes it, and a later retire_stale_batch is refused before any dialog; on Claude, a tools/call for retire_stale_batch, enroll or start_unattended_batch while the run is paused is refused with no Kernel mutation even when a phase admission was recorded.
start_unattended_batch with max_parallel 1 and lane_offers against an active Lane batch recorded with max_parallel 2 resumes that batch at max_parallel 2 instead of reporting batch_parallel_mismatch.
